title: SAEs Can Improve Unlearning: Dynamic Sparse Autoencoder Guardrails for Precision Unlearning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2504.08192v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine unlearning is a promising approach to improve LLM safety by removing unwanted knowledge from the model. However, prevailing gradient-based unlearning methods suffer from issues such as high computational costs, hyperparameter instability, poor sequential unlearning capability, vulnerability to relearning attacks, low data efficiency, and lack of interpretability. While Sparse Autoencoders are well-suited to improve these aspects by enabling targeted activation-based unlearning, prior approaches underperform gradient-based methods. This work demonstrates that, contrary to these earlier findings, SAEs can significantly improve unlearning when employed dynamically. We introduce $\textbf{Dynamic DAE Guardrails}$ (DSG), a novel method for precision unlearning that leverages principled feature selection and a dynamic classifier. translated_title: SAE可以改进机器遗忘：用于大语言模型精准遗忘的动态稀疏自编码器防护栏
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘是一种很有前景的方法，通过从模型中移除不需要的知识来提高大语言模型的安全性。然而，目前主流的基于梯度的遗忘方法存在诸多问题，如高计算成本、超参数不稳定、顺序遗忘能力差、易受再学习攻击、数据效率低以及缺乏可解释性。虽然稀疏自编码器（SAE）非常适合通过实现基于激活的定向遗忘来改善这些问题，但此前的方法表现不如基于梯度的方法。本工作表明，与这些早期发现相反，当动态使用时，SAE可以显著改善遗忘效果。我们提出了动态DAE防护栏（DSG），这是一种新颖的精准遗忘方法，利用有原则的特征选择和动态分类器。我们的实验表明，DSG大幅超越了领先的遗忘方法，取得了卓越的遗忘表现。
tldr: 本文提出动态稀疏自编码器防护栏（DSG），通过有原则的特征选择和动态分类器实现大语言模型的精准遗忘，其表现显著优于现有基于梯度的遗忘方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dynamic Sparse Autoencoder Guardrails (DSG), a novel precision unlearning method that leverages principled feature selection and a dynamic classifier, substantially outperforming leading gradient-based unlearning methods for LLMs.
